cpsc.Description: This recall involves Mamisan Pain Relieving Topical Ointment jars. The ointment comes in an orange container with a white continuous thread lid and has the Mamisan trademark printed on top of the lid and on the label. The ointment was sold in a 3.52 ounce plastic jar. The wraparound label includes instructions and drug facts. Only jars with UPC code 860006498115 are included in the recall.
cpsc.Title: Plantimex Recalls Mamisan Lidocaine Ointment Containers Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Child Poisoning; Violates Mandatory Standard for Child-Resistant Packaging
cpsc.ConsumerContact: Plantimex toll-free at 855-752-6869 from 9 a.m. to 4 p.m. PT Monday through Friday, email at customercare@plantimexusa.com with the subject "RECALL" or online at http://plantimexusa.com/contact.php or www.plantimexusa.com and contact us for more information.

Images.Caption: Recalled Mamisan Licodaine Ointment jar UPC - 860006498115
Recalled Mamisan Lidocaine Ointment 3.52 ounce jar
Recalled Mamisan Lidocaine Ointment jar non-child resistant packaging (continuous thread lid)

Retailers.Name: Walmart and Target stores nationwide and online at Target.com from April 2024 through October 2025 for about $10.

Distributors.Name: Plantimex Distributors, Inc., of San Diego, California

Hazards.Name: The ointment contains lidocaine, which must be in child-resistant packaging, as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act. The ointment's packaging is not child-resistant, posing a risk of serious injury or death from poisoning if the contents are swallowed by young children.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should immediately secure the recalled ointment jars out of the sight and reach of children and contact Plantimex to receive a free replacement lid. Once the product is secured with the replacement lid, consumers can use the product, as directed.

cpsc.Description: This recall involves certain glass bottles of Kirkland Signature Valdobbiadene Prosecco DOCG. The UPC is 196633883742 and the Costco Item Number is 1879870. The product was sold in a green bottle with purple foil on the top and a purple label with the words "Kirkland Signature Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore DOCG".
cpsc.Title: F&F Fine Wines Recalls Kirkland Signature Valdobbiadene Prosecco DOCG Bottles sold by Costco Due to Laceration Hazard
cpsc.ConsumerContact: Ethica Wines at 786-810-7132 from Monday through Friday from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. EST, email at customercare@ethicawines.com.

Products.Name: Kirkland Signature Valdobbiadene Prosecco DOCG bottles

Images.Caption: Recalled Kirkland Signature Valdobbiadene Prosecco DOCG bottle

Injuries.Name: F&F Fine Wines International, Inc. has received ten reports of the bottles shattering or breaking, resulting in one laceration injury.

Retailers.Name: Costco stores in IA, IL, IN, KY, MI, MN, MO, ND, NE, OH, SD, and WI from April 2025 through August 2025 for about $8.

Importers.Name: F&F Fine Wines International, Inc. dba Ethica Wines, of Miami, Florida

Hazards.Name: The Prosecco bottles can break or shatter, posing a laceration hazard.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled bottles and not attempt to open them. Consumers should discard the recalled bottles in their household trash and contact Ethica Wines for instructions on how to obtain a full refund from Costco.

cpsc.Description: This recall involves the Scripto® Premium Torch which has a four-position adjustable metal nozzle, adjustable flame, hands free operation lock, black ergonomic non-slip rubber grip, and a metal base with black velvet on the bottom. The UPC number "0-70257-52226-6" is printed on the back of the product box.
cpsc.Title: Calico Brands Recalls Scripto Premium Torches Due to Risk of Injury or Death from Fires and Burns; Violates Mandatory Standard for Multipurpose Lighters
cpsc.ConsumerContact: Calico Brands toll free at 800-544-4837 from 9 a.m. to 4 p.m. PT Monday through Friday, email at premiumtorchrecall@calicobrands.com, or online at www.calicobrands.com/premiumtorchrecall.html or at www.calicobrands.com and click on "Product Recall" at the bottom of the page for more information.

Retailers.Name: Walmart and Home Depot stores nationwide and online at Walmart.com and Homedepot.com from November 2024 through August 2025 for about $15.

Hazards.Name: The recalled torches violate the requirements of the mandatory safety standard for multipurpose lighters, posing deadly fire and burn hazards to consumers.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled torches and return them to the retailer for a full refund or store credit or contact Calico Brands for instructions on how to return the torches and receive a full refund. After contacting Calico Brands, consumers will receive a shipping label and appropriate hazmat packaging to return the torches free of charge.

cpsc.Description: This recall involves outdoor Sharper Image-Branded Tabletop Fire Pits and Sharper Image-Branded Tabletop Infinity Fire Pits. The units have a “77” logo on the front, a Lot Code sticker in the center of the base, a round black sticker marked “CHINA” with a 5-digit code, the letters KS-CY or KS-FC, and a date code in YYYY-MM-DD format. The Sharper Image-Branded Tabletop Fire Pits feature a small cylindrical concrete body with a removable snuffing lid and an open burn chamber at the top. The Sharper Image-Branded Tabletop Infinity Fire Pits feature a steel base and tempered‑glass side panels.
cpsc.Title: Allstar Recalls Sharper Image Tabletop and Infinity Fire Pits Due to Risk of Serious Injury from Burn and Fire Hazards
cpsc.ConsumerContact: Allstar toll-free at 855-215-5032 from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. ET Monday through Friday, email at allstarmarketing6861@sedgwick.com  or online at www.firepitrecall.expertinquiry.com or www.allstarmg.com and click on “Fire Pit Safety Recall” at the bottom of the page for more information.

Products.Name: Sharper Image Tabletop Fire Pits and Sharper Image Tabletop Infinity Fire Pits

Images.Caption: Sharper Image Tabletop Infinity Fire Pits

Injuries.Name: The firm has received four reports of ignited fuel escaping from the unit during use, resulting in four injuries including third and fourth degree burns to multiple body parts.

Retailers.Name:
Sold At:
Ace Hardware, Burlington, Home Depot, Lowe’s, Kohl’s, Marshalls, Nordstrom, Rite Aid, Target, TJ Maxx, Walgreens, Walmart and other retailers nationwide, and online, including Amazon.com and Hsn.com from January 2023 through June 2026 for between $30 and $50.

Importers.Name: Allstar Marketing Group, LLC, of Winston-Salem, North Carolina

Hazards.Name: Ignited flammable liquid can escape from the recalled fire pits or trigger flame jetting from the fuel containers, posing a risk of serious injury from burn and fire hazards.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using the recalled fire pits immediately and contact Allstar for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to register at www.firepitrecall.expertinquiry.com, write “RECALLED – DO NOT USE” in permanent marker, and submit three photographs following the instructions on Allstar’s recall page. After registration is confirmed, consumers should dispose of any remaining fuel in accordance with local hazardous-waste requirements and discard the recalled fire pits safely.

fsis.field_title: Example Farms Recalls Smoked Chicken Sausage Products Due to Possible Listeria Contamination
fsis.field_product_items: 12-oz. vacuum-sealed packages containing “EXAMPLE FARMS SMOKED CHICKEN SAUSAGE APPLE MAPLE” with lot code 26300 and a use-by date of 12/15/2026.
fsis.field_summary:
WASHINGTON, Nov. 8, 2026 – Example Farms LLC is recalling approximately 4,000 pounds of smoked chicken sausage products. The products subject to recall bear establishment number “P-00000” inside the USDA mark of inspection.

Consumers who have purchased these products are urged not to consume them. These products should be thrown away or returned to the place of purchase.
